Search for memo visibility enforcement. Look for:
1. Any code checking memo visibility permissions
2. Authorization checks before returning memo data
3. Query filters that limit memo results by visibility
4. API endpoints or service methods that enforce memo visibility

Search broadly for patterns like "visibility", "can_view", "authorized", "access" combined with "memo" to find all distinct enforcement sites.

- dataviz: Use this skill whenever you are about to create ANY chart, graph, plot, dashboard, or data visualization, in ANY output medium — an HTML or React artifact, inline SVG, plotting code in any library (matplotlib, plotly, d3, Recharts, …), an image/PNG you will render and upload, or a chart shared into Slack. Read it BEFORE writing the first line of chart code, choosing chart colors, building a stat tile / meter / KPI row, or laying out a dashboard. Produces visualizations that read as one system — elegant, accessible, consistent in light and dark — using a brand-neutral placeholder palette you swap for your own. Teaches a design-system-agnostic method: a form heuristic, a color formula with a runnable validator, mark specs, and interaction rules. Automated behaviors ("from now on when X", "each time X", "whenever X", "before/after X") require hooks configured in settings.json - the harness executes these, not Claude, so memory/preferences cannot fulfill them. Also use for: permissions ("allow X", "add permission", "move permission to"), env vars ("set X=Y"), hook troubleshooting, or any changes to settings.json/settings.local.json files. 9	)

11	func (*APIV1Service) parseMemoOrderBy(orderBy string, memoFind *store.FindMemo) error {
12		if strings.TrimSpace(orderBy) == "" {
13			return errors.New("empty order_by")
14		}
15	
16		// Split by comma to support multiple sort fields per AIP-132.
17		fields := strings.Split(orderBy, ",")
18	
19		// Track if we've seen pinned field.
20		hasPinned := false
21		hasExplicitTimeField := false
22	
23		for _, field := range fields {
24			parts := strings.Fields(strings.TrimSpace(field))
25			if len(parts) == 0 {
26				continue
27			}
28	
29			fieldName := parts[0]
30			fieldDirection := "desc" // default per AIP-132 (we use desc as default for time fields)
31			if len(parts) > 1 {
32				fieldDirection = strings.ToLower(parts[1])
33				if fieldDirection != "asc" && fieldDirection != "desc" {
34					return errors.Errorf("invalid order direction: %s, must be 'asc' or 'desc'", parts[1])
35				}
36			}
37	
38			switch fieldName {
39			case "pinned":
40				hasPinned = true
41				memoFind.OrderByPinned = true
42				// Note: pinned is always DESC (true first) regardless of direction specified.
43			case "create_time", "name":
44				// Only set if this is the first time field we encounter.
45				if !hasExplicitTimeField {
46					memoFind.OrderByTimeAsc = fieldDirection == "asc"
47				}
48				hasExplicitTimeField = true
49			case "update_time":
50				// Only set if this is the first time field we encounter.
51				if !hasExplicitTimeField {
52					memoFind.OrderByUpdatedTs = true
53					memoFind.OrderByTimeAsc = fieldDirection == "asc"
54				}
55				hasExplicitTimeField = true
56			default:
57				return errors.Errorf("unsupported order field: %s, supported fields are: pinned, create_time, update_time, name", fieldName)
58			}
59		}
60	
61		// If only pinned was specified, still need to set a default time ordering.
62		if hasPinned && !memoFind.OrderByUpdatedTs && len(fields) == 1 {
63			memoFind.OrderByTimeAsc = false // default to desc
64		}
65	
66		return nil
67	}
